High Court Of Madhya Pradesh
 At Jabalpur
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER

This is the fourth application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of CrPC for grant of regular bail relating to Crime No.06 of 2022 registered at Police Station Mahuljhir District Chhindwara (M.P.) for the offences under Sections 305, 376(2)(f), 376(2)(n), 376(2)(j), 376(2)(cha) of the IPC and 5(n)/6 of the POCSO Act.
He is in judicial custody since 16.01.2022.
The earlier application was dismissed on merits.
2. This time the bail is pleaded on the ground of delay in trial.
However, there is no material placed before this court to show that there is substantial delay in the trial.
Nor there is any order sheet to that effect has been placed on record by the applicant.
There is no material change in circumstances after dismissal of previous application on merits.
3. Consequently, the successive application is dismissed.
